commands.link.github.description: Link your GitHub account by link or one-time code
commands.link.github.param_method: How to authorise; auto picks the smoothest one that is configured
commands.link.param_member: Whose binding to show (defaults to you)
commands.link.show.description: Show the GitHub account someone linked
github.link.conflict: The GitHub account **{login}** is already linked to {holder}. One GitHub account can only belong to one Discord user — ask them to unlink first, or use another GitHub account.
github.link.done: Linked the GitHub account **{login}**. Use `/link remove` to undo it.
github.link.expired: Timed out and this attempt is void (the device code expired). Run `/link github` again.
github.link.failed: Linking failed: GitHub returned `{error}`. Run `/link github` again to retry.
github.link.start_failed: Could not start the GitHub authorisation ({error}). Try again later; if it keeps failing, check the network and the OAuth App configuration.
github.link.title: Link your GitHub account
github.not_configured: The GitHub integration is not configured: set `GITHUB_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID` in `.env` (the client_id of an OAuth App with "Enable Device Flow" ticked) and restart the bot.
github.show.empty: No GitHub account linked. Use `/link github` to link one.
github.show.title: GitHub binding of {member}
github.web.bad_state_body: This link was already used or has expired. Run `/link github` again in Discord.
github.web.conflict_body: That GitHub account is already linked to another Discord user. One GitHub account can only belong to one Discord user — ask them to unlink first, or use another account.
github.web.denied_body: You cancelled the authorisation on GitHub. Run `/link github` again in Discord to retry.
github.web.endpoint_off: The web flow needs the bot's inbound endpoint, but `WEB_PORT` is not configured (so it is not listening). Either set `WEB_PORT` and expose it through a tunnel/reverse proxy, or use `method:device`.
github.web.exchange_failed_body: GitHub refused to exchange this authorisation. Run `/link github` again in Discord to retry.
github.web.not_configured: The web flow is not configured yet: it needs `GITHUB_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET` and `GITHUB_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URI` (the latter must be set as the OAuth App's callback URL). You can use the device flow meanwhile: `/link github method:device`.
github.web.success_body: Linked the GitHub account {login}. You can close this page and go back to Discord.
modules.github_bridge.description: Link Discord users to GitHub accounts (device flow; stores identities, never tokens).
modules.github_bridge.name: GitHub accounts
